Know_Every_Thing.title: Activities at Nagarjuna Degree College
Know_Every_Thing.description: The institution fosters a holistic student experience through Statutory Cells ensuring safety and equal opportunities, Academic Enrichment enhancing learning with research and value-added programs, Community Service promoting social responsibility and cultural engagement.

descriptions.text: Rotaract club of Nagarjuna Degree College is an institution-based club associated with Rotaract club of Yelahanka, Installed in 2018 with 15 members. It is service club for young men and women who are dedicated to the community and international services it is club committed to the core values of Rotary international: Service, Fellowship,Diversity ,Intergrity Leadership. Under the motto service above self through sustainable projects. The efforts of this club start at the community level but knows no Rotaract limits in its out rich.

VisionMission.title: Vision
VisionMission.description: To hone one’s leadership and business abilities and  give young people the chance to respond to community needs and issues ,  offer chances for working together with the sponsoring rotary club and participate in society to inspire young people to join eventually.

VisionMission.title: Mission
VisionMission.description: The mission of Rotaract is to provide an opportunity for men and women to enhance the knowledge and skills that will assist them in personal development, to address the physical and social needs of their communities, and to promote better relations between all people worldwide through a framework of friendship and service.

ListPoints.text: Nagarjuna Degree College, in collaboration with Rotaract Club Yelahanka, organized a blood donation camp on campus. Students and staff actively participated, donating blood to support local hospitals and raise awareness about the importance of regular blood donation. The event was a great success, reflecting the spirit of service, compassion, and social responsibility.

Club had organized a social activity” Fist Full of Rice” on 29/12/2022.As part of this event our club members and student coordinators collected groceries from all students and faculties of Nagarjuna Degree College and were donated to AIMS Seva Ashrama and Snaha Jeevi Vrudha Ashrama, thus connecting with needy section of the society.

descriptions.text: NDC Leadership cell carves out the leadership qualities in the students and making them responsible enough to take the responsibility in every part of the work they take it in forefront.

Leadership is not about just delegating work or instructing things to the people, but the ultimate leader is the one who takes the team together and in every step being standing by the team in every work forefront and failure.
So, at NDC we develop all those qualities which make our student a successful leader throughout the lifetime.

Activities.title: Cultural Activities
Activities.description: India is a county of Tradition and Culture. This tradition finds reflection in the cultural activities at NDC. The various opportunities to showcase the hidden talents lead the students to holistic development.
